# Who may approve a Standards-exception: trailer, one sha256 a line: the hash of the maintainer's lower-case GitHub login
# (python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'<login>').hexdigest())"), since the repository is public and names
# no person. A commit that raises a baseline row or adds an access exception line needs a trailer in this form, naming
# a login whose hash is listed as the commit's parent had it:
#   Standards-exception: approved by <login>: <reason>
# A builder never writes its own: the trailer is the maintainer's approval of one change, given in that change's review.
# A commit that edits this file needs the same approval from a login already listed (scripts/baseline_history.py).
